items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Bill Cosby came and he had Sarah Vaughan with him... So he got up on the stage and he had fun with us... But he finally showed up, about a half an hour just ahead of our band, laughing and everything.

ctx.x: Okay because there was a Bob Crosby.
